purpose: Record forward, week by week, what an equal weighting of the same point-in-time universes would have returned, so that the residual sleeve's forward clock can be read as a comparison rather than as a bare return series.
why_this_exists: Step 222 found the composite's 80% control leg losing to an equal weighting of its own universe in sample, and Step 231 found the composite's edge over a blended equal-weight benchmark indistinguishable from noise at P(>0)=0.533. Step 230 and Step 232 then established that neither leg can be validated out of sample from free data. A forward record without a benchmark beside it would repeat the ambiguity for another 52 weeks.

relationship_to_the_frozen_protocol.reads: config/forward/sec_residual_controlled_sleeve_forward_v1.json, for its weights and cadence only
relationship_to_the_frozen_protocol.note: This is a measurement companion. It does not alter, reinterpret, or supersede the residual sleeve protocol, and its existence must not be treated as a change to that protocol's terms. If the residual sleeve clock never starts, this record simply stands alone.

tracked_series.name: equal_weight_narrow
tracked_series.universe: narrow SEC filer roster, tradable members at the governing quarterly decision

tracked_series.name: equal_weight_broad
tracked_series.universe: broad research panel roster, tradable members at the governing quarterly decision

tracked_series.name: blended_benchmark
tracked_series.definition: 0.8 x equal_weight_narrow + 0.2 x equal_weight_broad, matching the composite's sleeve weights

construction.weighting: equal across every tradable member; no selection of any kind
construction.rebalance: quarterly, on the same schedule the strategies use, held weekly between
construction.missing_price_policy: an issuer with no validated price is excluded and its weight held in cash, matching the base scenario

cadence.window: observed at or after 21:00 UTC on the decision Friday and before 21:00 UTC the following Friday
cadence.missed_snapshot_policy: a missed weekly window cannot be backfilled from a later vintage

what_this_can_and_cannot_show.can: whether the composite, once its clock runs, is beating a portfolio that makes no selection decisions at all
what_this_can_and_cannot_show.cannot: anything about the composite on its own. A benchmark is a denominator, not a verdict, and 52 weeks of either series alone settles nothing.

log_policy: decision and observation JSON Lines logs are independently hash-chained; duplicate, out-of-order, pre-freeze, changed, or unhashed records are rejected
promotion_authority: none. This protocol measures a benchmark and can never authorise trading of anything.
revision_policy: Any change to the construction, cost, cadence or tracked series creates v2 and marks this version superseded.
